QuestInfo.name: Rain's Maple Quiz 6
QuestInfo.2: When you level up, you get 5 Ability Points (AP) to use to upgrade your abilities. Use the hotkey S your AP.

0.0: Wow, you're pretty good. Are you assigning your Ability Points (AP) well? You know you get those after leveling up, right? Talk to me when you're ready for the 6th question.

1.0:
Every time you level up, you can raise your character's ability stats. How many ability points (AP) are you awarded after every level up? 

#L0##b2 points#l
#L1#10 points #l
#L2#5 points #k#l
1.1: That's right. Every time you level up, you're awarded #r5 AP#k, which can be used to raise your character's abilities. Press #bS#k after every level up and make sure to assign those points well.

0.0: Come on, you get more than 2 measly points! You should check your AP after leveling up by pressing S.
0.1: Nope, not 10 points. Press S to check.
